overview: An AI agent that analyzes CRM-style pipeline data to produce a probabilistic revenue forecast and a ranked list of at-risk deals with specific reasons and recommended next actions.
features: Pre-loaded synthetic CRM pipeline of about 150 deals
Weighted-pipeline forecast with a confidence range and baseline comparison
Rule-based risk scoring for stalled deals, engagement drop-off, missing stakeholders, and slipped close dates
AI-written risk explanations and specific next-best actions per deal
Leadership dashboard with charts, a ranked at-risk table, and a weekly review view
Deal detail view with contributing risk signals and editable deal data
